exposure: Interval of last seizure before pregnancy
cohort: 50 pregnant women with epilepsy (cases) and 150 randomly selected pregnant women without epilepsy (controls).
finding: Women with epilepsy had a slightly increased risk of adverse pregnancy, delivery, and perinatal outcomes compared to pregnant women without epilepsy.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery was caesarean section in 47.92%, vaginal delivery in 52.08%, and outlet forceps in 2.08% of the cases, while in controls, 20% delivered by caesarean section, 74.67% had vaginal delivery, and 4.17% were delivered by outlet forceps.
birth_weight: Babies with birth weight <2.5kg were more common in the epilepsy group (31.37%) compared to controls (46%).
